=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2414-2415 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` puts `FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME_ENABLED=false` and `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW=""` in front of the `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` call, and the reviewers say those values stay set in the calling shell after the call returns.
  WHY: The next step in the same process, `_mt_final_ci_merge_resume` (scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1873, called from 2125-2126), reads `false` and returns early, so the final-CI merge-resume pass is silently turned off for that sweep. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagrees: bash outside POSIX mode scopes these assignments to the function call, and review_merge_train.sh:1936 already relies on that.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2578-2618 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_gate`, when the caller's `skip=<pr>:<head>` entry matches its current head and it is the only waiter, `_merge_lease_queue_first` returns nothing, and the gate goes on to write a held lease that drops the caller's skip entry (the write is in `_merge_lease_write` at 2224-2228).
  WHY: A PR released unmerged (expired, revoked or ineligible) can take the lease again on the same head, which breaks skip-until-head-changes (plan line 335). Severities disagree: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, glm rated it NIT with confidence 2 because the behaviour is documented. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged it consistent with plan 2.5.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2389-2407 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_pr_eligible`, a holder whose head-gate is missing, pending or posted by another account counts as eligible for the whole idle window, and forever when MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES=0. So setting the variable to 0 also turns off the no-head-gate revocation.
  WHY: Plan D3 says to revoke a holder that has no pipeline head-gate success, and plan 2.3 says IDLE=0 should turn off only the idle test. Such a holder keeps blocking the base until the TTL (240 min). Severities disagree: sonnet rated it NIT, gemini and luna MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2416-2418 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` maps every `PR_CHECKS_WAIT_OUTCOME=failed` to `final_ci_failed`. That includes `ci_run_cancelled` (set at `_pr_wait_for_required_checks` 1196-1199 when `PR_CHECKS_RUNS_UNRUN > 0`), which covers runs that were cancelled or hit startup_failure.
  WHY: Plan D3 (docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md:53) revokes only for a final CI run that concluded with failure. The holder is revoked, and its `skip=<pr>:<head>` entry still matches after a rerun goes green on the same head, so the PR stays passed over. Waiters in this state are unlabelled. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2091-2097 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_revoke_enabled` defaults to `${MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED:-true}`, but none of the four workflows passes MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED or MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES from `vars`.
  WHY: Setting the repo variable has no effect in deployed runs, so the advertised Phase 2 kill switch and rollback cannot work and turning the feature off needs a code revert. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1765-1818 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: In `_mt_merge_lease_tick`, a labelled waiter with a matching `skip=<pr>:<head>` entry is skipped but keeps `ai:merge-lease-wait`. When no other eligible waiter exists, the tick logs `no_eligible_waiter` and leaves the lease free without granting or re-dispatching anyone.
  WHY: The sweep skips labelled PRs (.github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:686-691), so only this tick re-dispatches waiters. The skip-listed PR stays stuck until someone pushes to its branch by hand. Both rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash considers it a non-issue because the gate's lone-caller acquire bounds it.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_pr_eligible (`*)` branch of `case "${elig_gate}"`, no_head_gate) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: At grant time every waiter must have a pipeline head-gate success, but the rb-judge path labels the PR lease_wait before it posts the head-gate status (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2578-2584 vs 2609, and 2677/2708).
  WHY: When an rb-judge-approved waiter reaches the front, the tick logs `skipped reason=no_head_gate`, unlabels it and grants the lease to the next PR, which breaks queue order for every rb-judge merge. Rated MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says it self-heals and no queue position is lost.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2129 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The skip-list parse `sed -n '/^paths:$/q; s/^skip=//p'` depends on line order and matches loosely.
  WHY: An unexpected or malformed `skip=` line placed before `paths:` could corrupt MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS and skip valid PRs. Rated NIT. sonnet and glm checked the parse and found it correct.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan Phase 2 §2.6: "Env (defaults in pr_checks_lib.sh, wired as ${{ vars.X || 'default' }} in the four workflows): MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED ... MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES". G7 requires the kill switch to work "without a code change".
  expected_change_site: the env blocks next to MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED/MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (e.g. 1215-1217), review_autofix_sweep.yml, orchestrate_poll.yml and cancel_on_pr_close.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no workflow file is in the PR diff; a grep of .github/workflows finds no MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED or MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES, only the existing MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED/TTL_MINUTES/WAIT_LABEL lines; the changelog and fragment defer the wiring to "a later phase", which the issue and plan do not; the pipeline files_touched grant leaves out these workflows, so a scope extension or follow-up issue may be needed
- requirement: Plan Files & Modules: "README.md: rows next to the MERGE_LEASE_* rows at 151-155 (Phases 2-5)", meaning README rows for MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED and MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES
  expected_change_site: README.md merge-lease variable table (lines 151-155)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: README.md is not in pr_changed_files.txt; the table still ends at MERGE_LEASE_REF_PREFIX/FINAL_CI_MERGE_RESUME_ENABLED and documents neither new variable; README.md is also outside files_touched
- requirement: "the tick AND the gate grant the lease only to an eligible PR" (Phase 2 grant-time eligibility, issue #9805 Requirements §2, plan §2.5)
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_merge_lease_gate` (around lines 2575-2601)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` is called only from `_mt_merge_lease_tick`; the grant path in `_merge_lease_gate` (line 2582 `lease_first="$(_merge_lease_queue_first ..."`) checks only the skip list, so an ineligible PR can briefly acquire the lease. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say plan 2.5 waives this ("Eligibility is not re-checked there; the caller is already an approved merge path").
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick, skip-list pre-loop / `tick_first="$(_merge_lease_queue_first "${tick_base_prs}" "" "${MERGE_LEASE_SKIPS:-}" "${tick_excluded}")"` / `no_eligible_waiter` branch (diff hunk at about lines 1765-1818) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A skip-listed waiter keeps ai:merge-lease-wait and is passed over on every tick. With no other eligible waiter, the tick logs no_waiter/no_eligible_waiter and never grants it the lease.
  WHY: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:686-691 skips labelled PRs and only this tick re-dispatches them, so the PR stays stuck until a manual push. Suggested fix: fall back to one `_merge_lease_queue_first` call without the skip list, or unlabel skip-held waiters.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_pr_eligible `*)` branch (no hold_since → no_head_gate) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: At grant time a waiter needs a pipeline head-gate success, but scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2578-2584 labels lease_wait before the head-gate is posted at 2609 (same order at 2677/2708).
  WHY: rb-judge waiters at the front get skipped reason=no_head_gate and unlabelled, and the lease goes to the next PR, which breaks queue order. The main path (scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:312 then 326) is not affected.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_pr_eligible `PR_CHECKS_WAIT_OUTCOME = "failed"` → final_ci_failed; _pr_wait_for_required_checks lines 1196-1199 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Runs that were all cancelled or hit startup_failure are mapped to final_ci_failed, and REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW="" disables the re-dispatch at 1143-1147.
  WHY: Plan D3 (docs/plans/merge-lease-parallel-merges-plan.md:53) revokes only for a concluded failure. The skip entry stays after CI goes green on the same head. Suggested fix: require `${PR_CHECKS_RUNS_UNRUN:-0}` to be 0, or fail open.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_pr_eligible holder branch (idle test); tests/test_merge_lease.py test_idle_minutes_zero_turns_the_idle_test_off | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES=0 also turns off the no_head_gate revocation of holders.
  WHY: Plan 2.3 says 0 turns off only the idle test, so such holders keep the lease until the TTL (240 min).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_revoke_enabled; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1215-1216, 4734-4735, 4855-4856; review_autofix_sweep.yml:233; orchestrate_poll.yml:294-295; cancel_on_pr_close.yml:422-423 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: No workflow passes MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED or MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES from `vars`.
  WHY: The kill switch and rollback cannot take effect, and no later plan phase owns the wiring.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Plan §2.6 env wiring of MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED/MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES in "the four workflows" | Expected change site: env blocks in review_autofix.yml, review_autofix_sweep.yml, orchestrate_poll.yml, cancel_on_pr_close.yml | Evidence of absence: no workflow hunk; grep finds neither variable; outside files_touched (may need a scope extension or follow-up) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: README.md rows next to the MERGE_LEASE_* rows at lines 151-155 | Expected change site: README.md merge-lease variable table | Evidence of absence: README.md not changed; outside files_touched | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/review_merge_train.sh _mt_merge_lease_tick tick_holder_row jq selector `select(type == "object" and .number == $n)` matches by number only; add `--arg b "${tick_base}"` and `and .base == $b` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Checked and dismissed (not findings): gate grant-time eligibility (waived by plan 2.5); skipped lone caller acquires (matches plan 2.5); prefix-assignment leak (bash scopes it to the call; review_merge_train.sh:1936
